cover_letter.objective: Results-driven DevOps Engineer with 4.6 years of IT experience, including 3.6 years of hands-on experience building and managing CI/CD pipelines, administering Kubernetes clusters, and provisioning cloud infrastructure using Terraform. Experienced in automating deployments, improving infrastructure reliability, and supporting scalable, secure cloud environments.

highlights: Developed reusable Terraform modules for core AWS primitives (VPC, EC2, RDS, S3, Load Balancing), enabling consistent environment provisioning across dev, staging, and production and virtually eliminating config drift.

Built Jenkins CI/CD pipelines integrated with GitHub to automate build, test, and deployment workflows for multiple application teams, introduced Shared Libraries to standardize pipeline logic and reduce duplication.
Provisioned and managed Amazon EKS clusters with managed node groups deployed workloads via Helm and handled day-2 operations including node upgrades, resource quotas, and horizontal pod autoscaling.
Implemented Auto Scaling groups with ALB target-group health checks to absorb traffic spikes without manual intervention, improving application reliability during peak load events.

Deployed Prometheus and Grafana for EKS cluster and application-level monitoring, building dashboards that gave engineering teams real-time visibility into latency, error rates, and infrastructure saturation.
Stood up ELK Stack for centralized log aggregation across EC2 instances and Lambda functions, cutting average root-cause analysis time from hours to under 20 minutes during production incidents.
Automated OS patching, package installation, and compliance-baseline enforcement across 10+ EC2 instances with Ansible playbooks, reducing manual remediation work by approximately 60%.
Authored IAM policies, security group rules, and VPC network ACLs aligned with least-privilege principles, passing two internal security audits without critical findings.
Participated in on-call rotation and led post-incident reviews for four Severity-1 events, producing runbooks that measurably reduced recurrence rates for each class of incident.

Provisioned and managed Azure Virtual Machines, Virtual Networks, and Storage Accounts for a distributed application platform supporting 500+ internal users, maintaining a 99.9% availability SLA throughout the year.
Configured Azure Application Gateway with WAF rules and Azure Load Balancer for the web tier, enabling zero-downtime deployments and significantly improving the team's resilience to traffic spikes.

Centralized secrets management with Azure Key Vault, removing hardcoded credentials from five development teams' repositories and bringing the organization into compliance with internal security policy.

Deployed containerized microservices to Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS); managed Helm chart releases and integrated Azure Container Registry (ACR) into the image build pipeline for consistent artifact promotion.
Designed and maintained multi-stage Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines with approval gates and automated test steps, shrinking deployment cycles from two days to under four hours.
Partnered with the security team to implement Azure Active Directory RBAC across resource groups and enforce least-privilege access for developers, operators, and service principals.

Created and optimized PLSQL Packages, Procedures, Functions, Triggers, Views with robust exception handling to retrieve, manipulate, validate and migrate complex datasets in Oracle, automating routine tasks and improving operational efficiency.
Built interactive reports and RESTful APIs using Oracle APEX and ORDS to enhance system functionality and user experience.

Collaborated closely with cross-functional teams, including DBAs and ETL teams to coordinate code deployments, resolve dependencies, and optimize integrated workflows. Basic experience with Oracle forms and Reports for legacy system enhancements.

education.degree: Bachelor of Technology (Electronics and Communications Engineering)
